propositions: BindingStore's 799-line module conflates byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, and peer-state delegation with no cohesive owner, creating safety-rule gaps and regression risk
Production code mutates shallow `all_bindings()` results, violating encapsulation and enabling identity loss or comment re-posting

Retirement completion requires a durable tombstone agreement (tombstone, forward, reverse identities all matching) as authoritative intent, only revoked by explicit `unretire`, never by automatic liveness signals

Three internal owners (repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, recovery) must be extracted behind one unchanged public facade while preserving byte format, unknown fields, serialization order, and five-file selective-publication atomic semantics
Recovery completion must run after staleness validation but before remote issue fetch, with exact-match interrupted retirements idempotent and aborted on identity ambiguity or replace failure
